sentences.text: Every other read-aloud tool sends the page you're reading to a server.
It runs a real speech model, Kokoro, eighty-two million parameters, entirely on your own machine.
The words you are hearing right now were made by that model, in a browser, on a laptop.
Nothing you read is ever uploaded. There is no account, no API key, and no server to trust.
It is open source, and it is free forever.
The voice downloads once, about three hundred and ten megabytes, and then it works offline.
Install it, open any article, and press Alt plus R.
